approval: Owner instructed conversion, quantization and upload to a CrispEmbed HF repo with full wiring (2026-10-31). A variant is publishable only when its committed receipt shows every case token-ID exact against the pinned original Python model.

The verbatim Apache-2.0 text is the publisher's LICENSE.md from opendatalab/mineru-vl-utils at the pinned blueprint commit (byte-identical to licenses/mineru-vl-utils-LICENSE).

notice_file.note: Neither the model repository nor mineru-vl-utils at the pinned commit has a NOTICE file (2026-10-31), so none is redistributed; the card carries attribution and the Apache-2.0 section 4(b) statement of changes.

Q4_K.note: decoder mostly Q4_0 (896-wide rows fall back from Q4_K) with ffn_down Q4_K; the quantizer keeps vision and embeddings Q8_0

Q8_0_VF16.note: vision tower F16, decoder and embeddings Q8_0

qualification.gate: F32 ordinary and reuse-graph arms token-ID exact on every case, plus the 64-stage numerical and preprocessing gates; reduced precisions publish only when token-ID exact on every case
qualification.registry_alias: added only after upload, with the real published SHA256
qualification.recipe_note: crispembed-quantize keeps the vision tower at Q8_0 for any k-quant request, and the 896-wide decoder rows fall back from Q4_K to Q4_0, so 'Q4_K' is 1,099 MB vs 1,269 MB for Q8_0 and diverged on the Arabic case (41218174350). A 'decoder Q8_0' variant measured earlier was tensor-for-tensor Q8_0 and is not a recipe.

card.title: MinerU2.5-Pro-2604-1.2B
card.runtime_note: They target CrispEmbed's MinerU profile of its Qwen2-VL graph and are not llama.cpp mmproj pairs.
card.license_note: the model repository declares `license: apache-2.0` but ships no LICENSE file, so this is the publisher's own `LICENSE.md` from [opendatalab/mineru-vl-utils@c9797cde8f54](https://github.com/opendatalab/mineru-vl-utils/blob/c9797cde8f54cc48306196fc6aebe73ea31dd4a3/LICENSE.md)
card.not_verified: Not verified: GPU backends, multi-page documents, aggregate document benchmarks, contexts beyond the profile's 8,192 tokens.
card.usage:
MinerU2.5-Pro support is experimental and default-off in CrispEmbed:

```bash
CRISPEMBED_MINERU25_PRO=1 crispembed --ocr-pipeline page.png \\
  --ocr-engine mineru25-pro --ocr-rec {first}
```

Python (native inference with the pinned upstream document helper for full postprocessing):

```python
from crispembed import CrispMinerU
with CrispMinerU("{first}", image_analysis=True) as m:
    print(m.to_markdown(m.two_step_extract("page.png")))
```
